image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing in a museum setting. The image focuses on the torso, featuring a highly reflective breastplate with embossed details and gold-colored trim/straps at the shoulders and waist. Below the breastplate is a fauld (armored skirt) with horizontal lames. The background shows wooden doors and a light-colored wall.

artifact_observations.location: Gold trim on left shoulder and waist
artifact_observations.reasoning: The gold-colored trim appears slightly 'mushy' or lacking in fine crisp detail compared to the sharp steel reflections. It looks more like painted texture than distinct metal filigree, though this could be due to image resolution.

The connection point where the breastplate meets the armored skirt (fauld) is somewhat indistinct. The gold trim seems to blend into the steel plates without a clear mechanical fastening structure, which is common in AI generations of complex armor.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'gold' trim. In AI images, decorative metals often lose structural integrity and look like melted wax or low-resolution textures. Verify if the reflections on the steel match the geometry of the room (doors/walls) or if they are generic/hallucinated highlights.
